source.description: Taint source endpoint — the location where untrusted data enters the flow.

file.description: Workspace-relative path to the source file (e.g. internal/handlers/auth.go). Must NOT be absolute.

line.description: 1-based line number of the taint source.

expr.description: Go expression at the source (e.g. r.FormValue("scope")).

kind.description: Source kind label (e.g. http_param, form_value, header, cookie, query_param).

sink.description: Taint sink endpoint — the location where tainted data is consumed in a security-sensitive way.

file.description: Workspace-relative path to the sink file.

line.description: 1-based line number of the taint sink.

expr.description: Go expression at the sink (e.g. db.Query(query)).

kind.description: Sink kind label (e.g. sql_exec, sql_query, redirect, scope_grant).

max_depth.description: Maximum call-graph depth to explore when tracing the taint flow. Default is implementation-defined.

semgrep_tier.description: Semgrep tier to use for taint analysis. 'pro' = Semgrep Pro inter-procedural, 'intrafile' = OpenGrep intrafile, 'ce' = OpenGrep CE.

review_session_id.description: UUID identifying the current security review session.

code_ref.description: Git reference of the code being reviewed.

code_ref_dirty.description: True if the working tree has uncommitted changes at review time.
